summary: HNO International filed an 8-K regarding an Equity Purchase Agreement with Lambda Ventures LLC, granting the company the right to direct purchases of up to $30M of its common stock over 24 months. Shares are sold at 80% of the lowest traded price, with a $25K-$500K per put limit. 500,000 initial commitment shares were issued; additional shares are triggered per $2.5M drawn. A registration rights agreement was also entered. The structure is a distressed equity line (ELOC), not a typical capital return. No traditional return of capital to shareholders; watch dilution and market overhang from the floorless pricing mechanism.
